say:0:1012719101:0.text: This is the first time we've faced off on the battlefield.
say:0:1012719101:0.source_cn: 这还是第一次在战场上与你面对面，真不习惯啊，老战友。
say:0:1012719101:0.male: This is the first time we've faced off on the battlefield.
say:0:1012719101:0.female: This is the first time we've faced off on the battlefield.

say:1:1012719102:0.text: Eomir has long forgotten when we fought side by side in battle!
say:1:1012719102:0.source_cn: 伊米尔早已忘记我们一同赢下的荣耀了，他不再是我们的战友！
say:1:1012719102:0.male: Eomir has long forgotten when we fought side by side in battle!
say:1:1012719102:0.female: Eomir has long forgotten when we fought side by side in battle!

say:2:1012719103:0.text: Stop bringing up those galling memories!
say:2:1012719103:0.source_cn: 别再提那些令人恶心的回忆！曾与你们并肩作战是我的耻辱！
say:2:1012719103:0.male: Stop bringing up those galling memories!
say:2:1012719103:0.female: Stop bringing up those galling memories!
